You're right I wasn't clear about the situation, sorry about that. I thought the ETA-IL was the tourist visa. The background is that we submitted the B1 application but they requested more documents and received a final extension and deadline to submit them. The case is open, but the application has not been submitted yet. We plan to submit it very soon, but are waiting on one document before doing so. While that is happening, my husband is here with me on a tourist visa. We tried to request an extension via our attorney but they rejected the request. We hope that once we submit the application, they will grant the extension if there is an application being processed. 

That is the background info. I am now trying to plan ahead in the event of another rejection for an extension. If he has to leave and come back, what is the procedure to get permission to return? I don't know if there is an online application, if it resets, or anything. This is where I'm stuck.
